title: Drive not visible due to firmware RAID mode
summary: Fix drives that are visible in BIOS but not in Linux when firmware RAID is enabled.
error_patterns: Switch your BIOS from RAID to AHCI mode

steps.explain: Find the SATA or NVMe controller settings. Change the operation mode from 'RAID' to 'AHCI'. The setting might be named 'Intel Rapid Storage Technology', 'Intel RST', or 'VMD'.

warnings: If you dual-boot with Windows, you must prepare Windows for AHCI mode before changing this setting, or Windows may fail to boot.

rollback.explain: Re-enter firmware setup and change the controller mode back to RAID.
